specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Braided, Data Transfer, Fast Charging, Heat Resistant, High Speed

features: SUPERIOR DURABILITY: The Belkin BoostCharge Cable has been tested to survive over 10,000+ bends, and is more durable than a typical Type C to C cable
FLEXIBLE AND MANAGEABLE: Our Type C to C cable’s ultra-flexible braided technology gives you a USB-C charger cable that’s built for a long lifespan

MULTIPLE LENGTHS & COLORS: Belkin Type C to C cables are available in a variety of lengths and colors, so you can power up from an outlet on the other side of the room, or sync and charge your Android from your bag, with a color that matches your style

CHARGE, SYNC, AND CONNECT: Charge your USB-C devices, sync music or photos to a laptop, and transfer data from any USB-C port with these reliable USB-C cables that you can use at home, work, or on the go
USB-IF CERTIFICATION: SuperSpeed USB Compliance means that this cable has been certified by USB-IF to meet all electrical, mechanical, and environmental standards, ensuring a superior user experience
